en:
This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy. It is now 8:00 a.m.

THIS-IS-AN-EMERGENCY-ANNOUNCEMENT.
PLEASE-ASSEMBLE-IN-THE-GYM.

REFUSAL-TO-GET-ALONG...IS-GROUNDS-FOR-
PUNISHMENT.

Oh, Monodam, you're really obsessed with
this whole getting-along thing!
"Friends" is the only show he watches now!

IF-YOU-DON'T-GET-ALONG...I-WON'T-
FORGIVE-YOU.

I-WILL-USE-THE-EXISALS-TO-PEEL-YOUR-
FACES-OFF-LIKE-MANDARIN-ORANGES.

Ughhhh! That's so gory!
P-Please get along everyo—
...BLRGHBRBLBLRGHBRBLBLRGH!

Ah! She puked again!
Ooh, it's blue this time! How rare!

They say anyone who sees Monophanie's
blue puke will have good luck.
...So long, bear-well!

<CLT=cltMIND>Assemble in the gym, huh...
I have a bad feeling about this.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a normal bed.
It was pretty comfortable.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why did they go out of their way to make
this? What purpose could this serve?
